title: GATE testing and grooming by outside psychologists

tellings.quote: So, basically in 2004 2005, um I was tested by gifted and talented education. People may have heard the gate or the tag claims. Um I was tested with what was the Woodcock test of achievement.

plain: Jordan Jose, a man who says a secret UFO programme took him as a child, says that around 2004 or 2005 in Springville, New York, he was tested for GATE, a gifted and talented education programme for bright schoolchildren, using a standard school exam called the Woodcock test of achievement. He says outside psychologists then worked with him and groomed him over the following years, which he links to claims that such testing is used to pick out children for hidden programmes.
